## Description {#details}

<p>An Iterator for call edges, creates <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/aacalledges">AACallEdges</a> attributes in a lazy way.</p>


<p>This iterator becomes invalid if the underlying edge list changes. So This shouldn't outlive a iteration of <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/attributor">Attributor</a>.</p>


<p>Definition at line 5458 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/transforms/include/llvm/transforms/ipo/attributor-h">Attributor.h</a>.</p>
